This test verifies that dotted text without a scheme is not linkified
(golang/go#70033).

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.18
-- a/a.go --
package a //@documentlink(links)

var _ = []string{
	"p.name is %q",
	"go.dev is my favorite site!",
	"https://p.name is not a real site!",
}

// See example.com/doc or https://go.dev/doc.
-- @links --
a/a.go:6:3-17 https://p.name
a/a.go:9:27-45 https://go.dev/doc
